mapper.select: SELECT run_id, actor_team_id, project_id FROM afv_agent_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND owner_epoch = #{epoch} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND deadline_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM afv_canvas_agent_node_job j JOIN afv_agent_run r ON j.node_run_id=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.canvas_scope_json,'$.nodeRunId')) WHERE r.run_id=#{runId} AND j.cancel_requested=FALSE AND r.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND ((r.run_id=j.agent_run_id AND j.dispatch_state IN ('QUEUED','DISPATCHING')) OR (r.parent_run_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM afv_agent_run p WHERE p.run_id=r.parent_run_id AND p.status IN ('RUNNING','WAITING_EXTERNAL','WAITING_CONFIRMATION') AND p.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND p.deadline_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)))) AND r.next_sequence=1 AND r.deadline_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM afv_agent_model_call_usage u WHERE u.run_id=r.run_id)
SELECT * FROM afv_agent_run FORCE INDEX (uk_agent_run_id) WHERE run_id = #{runId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM afv_agent_run FORCE INDEX (uk_agent_run_id) WHERE run_id = #{runId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM afv_agent_run WHERE terminal_sequence IS NOT NULL AND ( projected_through_sequence < terminal_sequence OR projection_completed_at IS NULL ) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.* FROM afv_agent_run r FORCE INDEX (idx_agent_run_conversation_status) INNER JOIN afv_agent_conversation c ON c.conversation_id = r.conversation_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE r.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND r.parent_run_id IS NULL AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.status IN ( 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION', 'WAITING_EXTERNAL', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM afv_agent_run FORCE INDEX (idx_agent_run_conversation_status) WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND parent_run_id IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.* FROM afv_agent_run r FORCE INDEX (idx_agent_run_user_status) INNER JOIN afv_agent_conversation c ON c.conversation_id = r.conversation_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND r.parent_run_id IS NULL AND r.status IN ( 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION', 'WAITING_EXTERNAL', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') ORDER BY r.update_time DESC, r.id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT agent_state_session_id FROM afv_agent_run WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY agent_state_session_id

SELECT * FROM afv_agent_run FORCE INDEX (idx_agent_run_parent_status) WHERE parent_run_id = #{parentRunId} AND status IN ( 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION', 'WAITING_EXTERNAL', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_agent_run SET status = 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION', owner_instance_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, waiting_reply_id = #{replyId}, waiting_tool_call_id = NULL, waiting_tool_name = NULL, wait_expires_at = #{expiresAt}, deadline_at = #{expiresAt}, paused_through_sequence = #{pausedThroughSequence}, next_sequence = #{nextSequence}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND owner_epoch = #{ownerEpoch} AND owner_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_until > #{now} AND deadline_at > #{now}

UPDATE afv_agent_run SET status = 'WAITING_EXTERNAL', owner_instance_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, waiting_reply_id = NULL, waiting_tool_call_id = #{toolCallId}, waiting_tool_name = #{toolName}, wait_expires_at = #{expiresAt}, deadline_at = #{deadlineAt}, external_check_after = #{now}, external_resume_json = NULL, external_resume_sequence = NULL, external_resume_at = NULL, paused_through_sequence = #{pausedThroughSequence}, next_sequence = #{nextSequence}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND owner_epoch = #{ownerEpoch} AND owner_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_until > #{now} AND deadline_at > #{now}

UPDATE afv_agent_run SET status = 'RUNNING', owner_instance_id = #{newOwnerInstanceId}, owner_epoch = #{newOwnerEpoch}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, deadline_at = #{deadlineAt}, heartbeat_at = #{now}, waiting_reply_id = NULL, waiting_tool_call_id = NULL, waiting_tool_name = NULL, wait_expires_at = NULL, next_sequence = #{nextSequence}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{runId} AND status = 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION' AND owner_epoch = #{oldOwnerEpoch} AND waiting_reply_id = #{replyId} AND wait_expires_at > #{now}

UPDATE afv_agent_run SET external_resume_json = #{payload}, external_resume_sequence = #{sequence}, external_resume_at = #{now}, deadline_at = #{deadline}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, external_check_after = NULL WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND owner_epoch = #{epoch}

UPDATE afv_agent_run SET heartbeat_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), lease_until = LEAST( TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND, #{leaseMicros}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)), deadline_at) WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND owner_instance_id = #{ownerInstanceId} AND owner_epoch = #{ownerEpoch} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND deadline_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM afv_agent_run FORCE INDEX (idx_agent_run_lease) WHERE status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{now} ORDER BY lease_until, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM afv_agent_run FORCE INDEX (idx_agent_run_cancel) WHERE status = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED' AND cancel_acknowledged_at IS NULL AND (cancel_next_attempt_at IS NULL OR cancel_next_attempt_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY cancel_next_attempt_at, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT run_id FROM afv_agent_run WHERE status='WAITING_EXTERNAL' AND waiting_tool_name='await_canvas_run' AND canvas_scope_json IS NOT NULL AND external_check_after <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND wait_expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY external_check_after, id LIMIT 32

SELECT run_id FROM afv_agent_run WHERE status='RUNNING' AND external_resume_json IS NOT NULL AND (owner_instance_id=#{instance} OR lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND deadline_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY external_resume_at, id LIMIT 32
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_agent_run SET external_check_after=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 2 SECOND), update_time=update_time WHERE run_id=#{id} AND status='WAITING_EXTERNAL' AND waiting_tool_name='await_canvas_run' AND external_check_after <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE afv_agent_run SET external_resume_json=NULL, external_resume_sequence=NULL, external_resume_at=NULL, update_time=update_time WHERE run_id=#{id} AND owner_epoch=#{epoch} AND external_resume_sequence=#{sequence}
